justification: In `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UnsynchronizedReader.java`, the class is a small abstract base with one constructor, one package-private `checkOpen()` helper, `close()`, `isClosed()`, `setClosed()`, and a generic `skip(long)` implementation; it has no large method set or separate feature clusters. The subclass `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UnsynchronizedBufferedReader.java` contains the buffering, mark/reset, peek, and read logic, which shows the responsibilities are already split rather than concentrated in this base class.
